artefacts.title: Supreme Court order adopting FRCP 6 (1938 amendment), U.S. Reports vol. 308
artefacts.pending_case_language: Rule 86. Effective Date. These rules will take effect on the day which is 3 months subsequent to the adjournment of the second regular session of the 75th Congress, but if that day is prior to September 1, 1938, then these rules will take effect on September 1, 1938. They govern all proceedings in actions brought after they take effect and also all further proceedings in actions then pending, except to the extent that in the opinion of the court their application in a particular action pending when the rules take effect would not be feasible or would work injustice, in which event the former procedure applies. [308 U.S. at 104 of the Rules, PDF p.838]
artefacts.notes: Original Rules: this extract is the Chief Justice's letter of submittal (Dec. 20, 1937), the Act of June 19, 1934, and Rule 86 (effective date and pending-case clause), PDF p.838. Rule 6(a) original computation text is in ur308-civ-1938-text. Order extract also includes the Chief Justice's letter of transmittal and any dissents/statements printed with it. Original volume PDF is 135 MB (over the 20 MB cap): only this text extraction is stored; see README.md for the re-derivation command.

artefacts.title: Supreme Court order adopting FRCP 6 (1963 amendment), U.S. Reports vol. 374
artefacts.pending_case_language: (Mar. 18, 1963 order amending Rule 86(e)): (e) EFFECTIVE DATE OF AMENDMENTS. The amendments adopted by the Supreme Court on January 21, 1963, and transmitted to the Congress on January 21, 1963, shall take effect on July 1, 1963. They govern all proceedings in actions brought after they take effect and also all further proceedings in actions then pending, except to the extent that in the opinion of the court their application in a particular action pending when the amendments take effect would not be feasible or would work injustice, in which event the former procedure applies. [374 U.S. 872, PDF p.642]
artefacts.notes: Two orders: Jan. 21, 1963 (adopts amendments incl. Rule 6, with Black/Douglas statement) and Mar. 18, 1963 (amends Rule 86(e): effective July 1, 1963 and the pending-case clause). Saturday treated like Sunday/holiday in Rule 6(a). Order extract also includes the Chief Justice's letter of transmittal and any dissents/statements printed with it.
